summary: Native planner bridge contract for W19: one bounded JSON stdin request (schemaVersion:1, nowUtc, account:{accountId,ledgerId,epoch,head,ref,observedAtUtc,policy,reservations}, projects:[{projectName,projectId,ledgerId,epoch,head,ref,observedAtUtc,records: [{path,record}],verifiedSourceLeases:[...]}], coverage:{accountId,ledgerId,epoch,head,observedAtUtc,projects:[{projectId,ledgerId,epoch,head}],complete,sessions:[{sessionId,projectId,agentId,kind,status}]}). W19 supplies ONLY verified existing-auth native reader outputs; JS reuses canonical project normalizer, verifies exact membership/head/epoch/time and reservation identity, projects account occupancy onto projects; missing authoritative coverage holds all dispatch. Policy and reservations use native camelCase records; no WQ07 token interpretation. No auth or Git calls in this bridge. Source leases remain unverified without exact native source evidence; no synthetic promotion. Output plan and authority echo; host must reverify exact heads and use existing native reservation/exclusion protocol.
